GENERATE BURST KL-10-SW — Run C-9 P4, M3 consistency fix (Matt: helm, NE tabard pattern, S stance). task_id "KL-10-SW".

Use image_gen in EDIT mode on IMAGE 1 (the knight, painted in the hand of a c. 1530 Flemish manuscript, background flat green). Change ONLY the direction: turn him HALFWAY back toward the viewer, from the side view (facing screen-left) 45 degrees toward the camera, so he faces diagonally down-left: his whole body turns together (feet, hips, chest, helm). The helm stays EXACTLY the helm of IMAGES 1 and 2 (rounded skull, red-brown hatching, rounded close-fitting visor with one row of small holes) — never a pointed or beak visor. The pollaxe stays in his ANATOMICAL RIGHT hand, upright, butt on the ground; same rest stance.
Keep EVERYTHING ELSE exactly as it is: the camera, light, size and framing, flat pure #00ff00 background. Paint in EXACTLY the same hand (line, red-brown hatching, uneven washes, gouache-like steel). For this step the REGISTER CARD above is satisfied BY THE IMAGES: do not re-render or restyle.

One image_gen EDIT call. ONE retry only if the helm is pointed or beak-shaped, he is not at a clear 45-degree diagonal toward the lower-left, the pollaxe changed hands, or the background is not flat green — name the reason. Copy the output to out/KL-10-SW.png with sha256. No code. No other files. No web.
RETURN: receipt task_id "KL-10-SW"; images = the file with prompt, references (role + path) and elapsed_s; calls_used = the TRUE number of image_gen calls; status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.

references.role: IMAGE 1 — THE IMAGE TO EDIT (the knight, true side view facing screen-left, with his correct helm)
IMAGE 2 — the same knight facing the viewer (his front, heraldry and correct helm)
